intent: Eight original family-notice tasks resolve those days, assign opposite pictured stations to Lian and Bo, distinguish separate roles from an unstated order, read each person's own-bowl scope, keep Saturday availability separate from weekday roles and combine advance notice with cooperative purpose. Fresh community-reading-room transfer changes the setting and rejects automatic carryover and speed ranking.
picturePurpose: Original vegetable-washing station versus table-setting station supports opposite role-to-station choices. The picture does not establish the people, family size, completion or an order between jobs; exact assignments come from the notice.

items.material:
A FAMILY PLAN ON THE FRIDGE
Dad prepares dinner on Monday and Wednesday.
Lian washes the vegetables on those days.
Her brother, Bo, sets the table on the same days.
After dinner, everyone puts away their own bowl.
These weekday roles do not decide the Saturday jobs.
On Saturday, we check who is free before choosing the jobs.
If you cannot do an agreed job, tell the family before it is time to start.
The plan on the fridge is not a race to find the fastest person.
It helps us share the work and notice when someone needs help.

transfer.passage:
SATURDAY AT THE COMMUNITY READING ROOM
Ivy and Ken helped on Tuesday. A new notice says that Saturday jobs will be assigned only after the organiser checks who is available that day. Everyone should put away their own materials after the session. Anyone unable to do an agreed job should tell the organiser before it starts. The aim is to share the work, not to rank people by speed.
transfer.stem: Which plan follows the new notice?

options.text: Give Ivy and Ken all Saturday jobs because they helped on Tuesday, without checking again.
Choose the fastest person to put away everyone's materials and do every other job.
Check Saturday availability before assigning jobs, and ask for advance notice if an agreed task cannot be done.

answer.display: Check Saturday availability before assigning jobs, and ask for advance notice if an agreed task cannot be done.

explanation.strategy: 先限定星期与人员可用性，再核对无法履约时的说明要求，不能把上次参加当成本次确认。

steps.text: Ivy和Ken周二帮过忙，但周六安排要先检查当天谁有空。
steps.reason: 过去一次参与不等于本周六的空闲已经确认。

steps.text: 如果无法做已约定的任务，应在开始前告诉组织者，让安排能够调整。
steps.reason: 这项提前说明要求与先查空闲的安排可以同时满足。

steps.text: 通知还要求各自归还自己的材料，并明确不按速度给人排名。
steps.reason: 不能把所有收拾和其他工作都推给一个“最快的人”。

distractors.reason: 跳过周六空闲确认，把周二帮忙直接扩大为周六包办所有工作。
既违背各自收好材料的要求，也把分担工作改成了速度排名。

explanation.pitfall: 时间范围变了，人员安排要重新核对；“各自”不能被改成“一人包办”。
